items.name: Unify InformationDetail.vue between employee and profile
items.description: src/pages/setting/pages/profile/pages/detail/components/InformationDetail.vue duplicates src/pages/employee/pages/detail/components/InformationDetail.vue (same IEmployeeById detail list; profile's is a field subset with only the evaluatorLevel/managementPosition rows and reset-password/delete menu actions removed). Make the employee version canonical: extract its menu-action area to a slot, delete profile's copy, have ProfileDetailPage.vue consume the employee component with its own menu slot content.
items.evidence: bunx eslint on all 3 touched files — 0 errors. bunx vue-tsc --noEmit — clean. bunx vitest run — 20 files, 252 tests passed. grep confirms no remaining importer of deleted profile/InformationDetail.vue.
